identityPolicy: New resource IDs use RES#000001 format and are permanent; tags are English snake_case. Existing species/technology IDs are not migrated. Never sort/reallocate these IDs.

runtimePolicy.unknownValues: null means unresolved, not zero, none or unrestricted.
runtimePolicy.sourceBindings: Links are possible design outputs, not guaranteed products or completed taxonomy. They do not consume inventory or create items.
runtimePolicy.processingLinks: Historical process profiles remain design candidates. Explicit endpoints and auxiliary materials do not define executable recipes, quantities, facilities or technology unlocks.
runtimePolicy.services: Draft, transport and work are services, not storable inventory resources.
runtimePolicy.provenance: Resource IDs may aggregate compatible material categories; future GameState inventory lots must preserve source species/material, viability and quality before substitution.

unresolvedSources.reason: World water access and collection actions are not yet defined as source entities.
Conditional manure sources are documented for managed animal cases; actual husbandry, collection and broader domestic entities remain under design.
Fiber-bearing plant entity groups, harvesting and separation methods remain under design; exact scientific species are optional.

reviewIssues.resolution: A generic grain or wood resource does not erase botanical identity, seed viability, preservation state or quality. Model these in per-game inventory lots.
Raw crop resources are not automatically edible; preparation, preservation and nutritional rules remain undefined.
Nickel materials, manganese materials and seabed nodules do not unlock historical extraction; world scope and technology restrictions still apply.
Animal products distinguish horns/antlers and raw/processed materials. Honor animal availability constraints and input provenance policies; do not double count raw inputs and processed outputs.
